items.t: Method AI — Enabled Method AI to set a screen-level Grid View as the default view.
Method AI — Fixed Runtime AI's reset summary to include read-only field customizations.
Runtime Customization support tool — Added an internal tool for Method support staff to temporarily hide Runtime customizations.
Method AI — Added BigQuery logging of Method AI conversation history for internal analysis.
Method AI — Fixed Method AI conversation logging to capture replies on failed action-set builds.
Method AI — Fixed Method AI's Action Editor copilot replacing the wrong action in App Routines.
Method AI — Stopped Method AI from reloading the screen when no change was made.
Method AI — Fixed Method AI control placement so hidden controls no longer reserve layout space.
Method AI — Updated Method AI's reset summary to use plain language instead of raw property names.
Method AI — Fixed Runtime AI's decline message to stop referencing a nonexistent draft step.
Method AI — Improved Method AI's error handling to show a friendly message instead of a raw error.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where Runtime AI's Build-mode decline message implied Ask mode.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where Method AI edited the wrong action step after a nested If or Loop.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where Method AI failed to add steps that declare and use a new action result together.
Method AI — Enabled Method AI's Action Editor Build mode by default for all accounts.
Xero Sync — Fixed an issue where Refetch from Xero did not resolve invoice sync conflicts.
Audit Trail — Enhanced the audit trail to record every QuickBooks and Xero disconnect or permission change.
User Management — Fixed an issue where resending an invitation wasn't rate-limited on single-entity accounts.
Signature — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the Signature component.
Multi-select — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the multi-select dropdown.
Label — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the Label component.
Toggle — Fixed an issue where toggle switches couldn't be turned on with the Enter key.
Typography — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the Typography text primitive.
App Activation — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the App Activation banner and overlay.
Runtime Interface — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the runtime translation layer.
Types library — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the shared types library.
Styles — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the shared styles and theme tokens.
Gallery — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the Gallery component.
Editable Grid — Fixed an issue where a numeric Text Area column could crash the Editable Grid.
Banner — Added automated test coverage and requirement records for the Banner component.
